metadata.title: PoShLog.Sinks.MSSqlServer
metadata.description:
PoShLog.Sinks.MSSqlServer is extension module for PoShLog core library - https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/PoShLog.
It contains sink that writes log messages into MSSQL database.

For documentation check PoShLog wiki - https://github.com/PoShLog/PoShLog/wiki
